title: GPU unit tests job on self-hosted Windows runner fails downloading openvino_package with 'Missing file at path: set_output' runner command error
signature: download-artifact action fails with Action failed with error: Missing file at path: set_output runner file command, causing self-hosted Windows runner job to abort|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Download OpenVINO package step succeeds in extracting/verifying the artifact but then fails with 'Action failed with error: Missing file at path: ...set_output_<guid>'; the subsequent Upload GPU unit test results step then fails because the local upload-artifact action checkout is missing.

root_cause: The custom 'akashchi/download-artifact' action successfully downloaded and extracted the openvino_package artifact (SHA256 verified) but then failed with 'Action failed with error: Missing file at path: ...set_output_<guid>' when it tried to write its outputs via the GitHub Actions runner file command mechanism. This is a self-hosted Windows runner infrastructure issue: the runner's per-step temp file used for GITHUB_OUTPUT/set_output communication was missing on disk at the moment the action tried to write to it, most likely because the runner's _work/_temp/_runner_file_commands directory was cleaned/rotated concurrently, or a prior cleanup/orphan-process-kill step on this runner (ov-dmz-56, intel-gpu group) removed the temp directory mid-job. Because this step failed, the job never checked out the local 'upload-artifact' action repository, so the later Upload GPU unit test results step failed for the unrelated secondary reason of a missing action.yml.
reproduction_steps: N/A - this is a transient self-hosted Windows runner infrastructure failure (missing _runner_file_commands temp file) and is not reproducible by rerunning user code locally. Rerunning the workflow on a healthy runner instance would be the way to confirm transience, but this doctor does not re-run pipelines.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'GPU unit tests' job on a different self-hosted Windows runner instance (or retry after runner ov-dmz-56 is confirmed stable) since this looks like a transient runner-side missing temp-file issue, not a code issue introduced by PR #38795.

Check whether any step earlier in this job (or a concurrent job on the same runner) deletes or rotates C:\actions-runner\_work\_temp\_runner_file_commands\ mid-run, which would explain the missing set_output file.
Inspect runner ov-dmz-56 (intel-gpu group) health/disk space and GitHub Actions Runner version/logs for known issues with file-command temp files on Windows runners.
Consider adding a retry/continue-on-error wrapper around the download-artifact step for known-flaky self-hosted Windows runners, or add a runner health check before the Windows GPU test jobs start.
prevention_strategies: Monitor self-hosted Windows GPU runners for premature cleanup of _work/_temp directories during active jobs; ensure no scheduled cleanup/orphan-process scripts run against a runner's _temp directory while a job step is still writing to its runner-file-commands output file. Add alerting on repeated 'Missing file at path: ...set_output_*' errors on the intel-gpu Windows runner group to detect systemic runner instability early.
historical_context: No prior post-commit investigation in this knowledge base matches this exact signature (download-artifact action failing on the runner's set_output file command). Related but distinct Windows GPU/runner infrastructure issues previously recorded include: locked tbb12.dll during package extraction (pattern 514ffa2ab52ad344, 14 occurrences), PowerShell execution policy errors (pattern 3be0e72d6ae29098, 5 occurrences), and missing onednn license file during extraction (pattern 33e8544b41961fd6, 1 occurrence) - all on the same 'Windows GPU unit tests' job family, suggesting this job/runner pool has had recurring infra flakiness of different root causes.
